name: Enterprising Scallywag
oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, create a Treasure token. (You descended if a permanent card was put into your graveyard from anywhere.)
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you descended this turn, create a Treasure token. (You descended if a permanent card was put into your graveyard from anywhere.)

needs.what: a per-player turn-ledger value (or condition) counting permanent cards (artifact, battle, creature, enchantment, land, planeswalker; not tokens) put into that player's own graveyard from any zone this turn, e.g. {"permanent_cards_to_your_graveyard_this_turn": "you"} compared > 0, usable as an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition (rule 702.170, 'you descended this turn')
needs.why_existing_wont_do: permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn counts only permanents leaving the battlefield (tokens included, every controller), missing milled/discarded permanent cards; cards_to_graveyard_this_turn counts every card of any type into every graveyard with no player spec, so an instant milled or a card hitting an opponent's graveyard would wrongly satisfy it; has_turn_flag has no engine-set descend flag
